name: MERF Real-Time Rendering
definition: A real-time rendering implementation as a Javascript 3D (three.js) web application, orchestrated by a single GLSL fragment shader, using a multi-resolution hierarchy of occupancy grids for efficient ray marching.
summary: MERF Real-Time Rendering is a WebGL-based viewer for Memory-Efficient Radiance Fields that prioritizes browser portability and memory efficiency over CUDA-based accelerators like Instant-NGP.
